answer: Quadratic staking erosion transforms the cost of Byzantine participation into a steep terrace of expenditure where marginal capital outlay outpaces extracted value at every scale. By tethering security to non-linear slashing, the protocol dissolves the fable that Sybil clusters can maintain a cost-efficient attack. This liquidity-sink structure serves as a sovereign haven, ensuring that the consensus threshold forces an exponentially prohibitive price on any actor attempting systemic disruption.
